name: Squeeze-release directional breakout momentum — ride the trend out of a volatility coil
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (the CONTINUATION read of the same bb_width squeeze that bollinger-squeeze-release-reversion-regime-break trades for REVERSION; opposite trade off the same setup): low Bollinger Bandwidth (bb_width) marks a volatility coil — a compressed, low-energy range where positioning quietly builds. Such squeezes resolve violently, and the direction of resolution is tradeable: the reversion spec (existing) buys a LOW bb_z inside the squeeze betting the range holds; THIS spec waits for the squeeze to RELEASE UPWARD (bb_z crossing up through a positive breakout level, i.e. price thrusting above the upper band out of the coil) and rides the directional expansion that follows (the documented squeeze-breakout / volatility-cycle continuation). The two are complementary regime calls on the same coil: range-holds-reversion vs range-breaks-continuation. Entry: bb_width below a fitted squeeze ceiling (coil present) AND bb_z crosses UP through a fitted positive breakout level (upward release). Exit: bb_z crosses DOWN back toward the mean (thrust spent / failed breakout) or stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if an unconditional momentum long matches the deflated Sharpe, the squeeze-release adds no timing edge. Disconfirmer 2: this is the directional-continuation inverse of bollinger-squeeze-release-reversion on the SAME bb_width/bb_z features — the two must NOT be double-counted (they are opposite resolutions of one coil). Disconfirmer 3: squeeze breakouts fake out often; if the bb_width squeeze gate adds nothing over a bare bb_z breakout, the coil thesis is unsupported. Disconfirmer 4 (cost): the expansion must clear ~20bps round-trip net. Price/TA-only — always-on, no feed dependency.
catalyst: an upward release out of a low-bb_width volatility coil — a squeeze-breakout continuation
